Frequently Asked Questions

How does the tier progression work?

Each tier level permanently upgrades your planning history limit (from 3 plans on Free up to 100 plans on God tier), expands your analytics scope (from Today focus up to Diurnal peak study time & Heatmap), and unlocks active goal slots and advanced AI features.

How does the God Trial work?

You get 3 days of full God tier features (100-plan history, Diurnal distribution, Peer Benchmarks, Study Pattern AI, unlimited goals) completely free. No credit card needed. Download the app to activate.

How much do the paid tiers cost in INR?

PlanBot Pro is ₹99/month. Elite is ₹129/month. God tier is ₹249/month. You can also save 30% by choosing yearly billing.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. Manage your subscription through Google Play at any time with zero cancellation fees.

Can I use PlanBot on iPhone?

PlanBot is currently Android only. iOS support is planned for the future.

Is there a refund policy?

Yes. All Google Play standard refund policies apply. View our full refund policy page for details.

All purchases made through Google Play. Download the app to subscribe.
